performance.timing_definition: Differences between adjacent checkpoint elapsed_s values inside the same log and the same (independent models, histories per update) execution segment. The first checkpoint of every segment is excluded; no interval crosses a restart.
performance.scope: Measured saved-checkpoint intervals only; no extrapolated future timing. Checkpoint kernel timing excludes serialization outside the timed training call.

scope: Fixed nonlinear Table 1 reference material, unchanged model/loss/scales, three data arms and three independent training-noise realizations. B uses greater computation. This project extension does not establish robot, MPC, or RL benefit.

local_recovery.scope: Zero-state local quantities; full nonlinear histories use the original potentials.

revisit_decision_evidence.conclusion: The fixed candidate set has no strict late optimum. Matching its ranking does not demonstrate history-dependent action selection. Near ties use explicit uniform choice.

observed_conclusions.data_quantity_B: More random data improves ideal F1/F2/F4/F5/F6 mean RMSE and many noisy stress-controlled whole-history errors. It does not improve every family or tail: noisy F2 cluster-mean RMSE and F3 mean/worst RMSE worsen. B is not equal compute.
observed_conclusions.recovery_excitation_C: Replacing half the history budget improves noisy F2/F3 mean RMSE, but does not repair recovery identification. Ideal whole-history mean RMSE worsens in all six families; noisy effects depend on realization and metric. C/noise2 worsens F1/F4/F5/F6.
observed_conclusions.recovery_bias: All 45 noisy models retain about half the reference local recovery time. C has worse F6 recovery-RMSE medians in all three noise realizations; both B and C have worse recovery-integral absolute-error medians than A in all three. Forward prescribed-strain replay already shows constitutive error, so this is not solely an inverse-solver issue.
observed_conclusions.completed_fixed_budget: Stop this study at the fixed budget. No extra training, new loss, new network, S, RL or hardware execution was started.

applicability.material: Fixed original nonlinear Table 1 isotropic small-strain material, six physical tensor components, virgin episode initial state, continuous state within each history.
applicability.evidence_domain: Only the executed F1-F6 histories and prescribed grids; no continuous-box guarantee or new acceptance threshold is inferred.
applicability.next_stage_candidate: Frozen A ideal and the bounded B ideal data-scale comparator can support a future compatible contact-mapping investigation alongside the analytical reference oracle. Noisy models remain negative controls for recovery/revisit prediction.
applicability.unresolved_domains: Fast full-amplitude random paths and maximum volumetric strain holds retain large stress errors; noisy recovery and action-response magnitudes remain biased.
not_evaluated: unknown initial material state or parameters

training_compute.compute_scope: New training only; reused models are excluded. B is not equal compute.
training_compute.total_optimizer_updates_definition: Retained training trajectories of the 50 new models: 20,000 updates each. This excludes discarded work at execution changes.
training_compute.discarded_work_bound_definition: At most one checkpoint interval per affected model per recorded microbatch switch. This is an upper bound, not a measured count.
training_compute.interrupted_wall_time_scope: execution_changes.seconds_since_checkpoint_upper_bound includes downtime between interruption and continuation; it is not actual compute time.
training_compute.other_arithmetic_scope: Compilation and final training-loss/gradient evaluations are additional work outside retained Adam update counts.

throughput.timing_definition: Differences between adjacent checkpoint elapsed_s values inside the same log and the same (independent models, histories per update) execution segment. The first checkpoint of every segment is excluded; no interval crosses a restart.
throughput.scope: Measured saved-checkpoint intervals only; no extrapolated future timing. Checkpoint kernel timing excludes serialization outside the timed training call.

execution_changes.reason: User requested higher training throughput; change execution grouping only
execution_changes.uncheckpointed_compute: Interrupted work since the last 250-update checkpoint was not retained. At most 250 updates per model may have been computed and are not part of the retained 20000-update trajectory.
execution_changes.unchanged: All data, norms, full-history length, model, loss, Adam state/schedule and retained update budget; FP32 sum grouping may change roundoff.

execution_changes.reason: User explicitly authorized greater GPU/RAM use and parallel solves

training.reference_q_scope: Only in separate reference archives; absent from training observations.

training.initial_state: Each history is independent virgin equilibrium; no within-history resets.

noise_realizations.first_100: Reuse the archived noise arrays exactly.

artifact_package.archive_scope: Only this study run, its compact results, source and configurations. Ten reused models and reused diagnostic arrays are actual files inside this run.
artifact_package.archive_index_snapshot: The archive contains the index before its own digest and byte count are added. The external checksum authenticates the archive; artifact-files.json hashes every other included member, including that index snapshot.
